commands.title: Import a remote battle map
commands.description: Download a public HTTP image, create a campaign map, and optionally make it active.

commands.title: Move a player or NPC actor
commands.description: Move a controlled actor to a grid position and update every connected client.

commands.title: Roll dice as a player or NPC actor
commands.description: Make a persisted public or secret dice roll in the name of a controlled actor.

commands.title: Create a player or NPC actor
commands.description: Place a live player or NPC actor on a map. DMs may create either; players may create only an actor controlled by themselves.

commands.title: Speak as a player or NPC actor
commands.description: Send an in-world chat message using a controlled actor's name while retaining the controlling identity for audit.

commands.title: Update a player or NPC actor
commands.description: Change actor state such as HP, conditions, visibility, name, notes, disposition, or controller. Existing campaign-role rules are enforced.

commands.title: Set campaign atmosphere audio
commands.description: Play, change, or clear a campaign audio asset.

commands.title: Set campaign atmosphere effect
commands.description: Set or clear the active visual atmosphere effect for a campaign.

commands.title: Set campaign vibe period
commands.description: Change the active configured campaign vibe period.

commands.title: Create a campaign character
commands.description: Create a real campaign character owned by the connected player, or by a selected campaign member when connected as GM.

commands.title: Adjust a character's HP
commands.description: Apply healing or damage to a campaign character controlled by the connected player, or any character when connected as DM.

commands.title: Add an actor to combat
commands.description: As GM, add an actor to initiative and optionally roll its initiative immediately.

commands.title: End combat
commands.description: End the current combat as GM.

commands.title: Advance combat
commands.description: Advance to the next actor and round as GM.

commands.title: Remove an actor from combat
commands.description: As GM, remove an actor from the initiative tracker.

commands.title: Start combat
commands.description: Start the initiative tracker as GM.

commands.title: Activate a campaign map
commands.description: Make an existing campaign map current and synchronize it to connected players.

commands.title: Control fog of war
commands.description: Reveal or hide selected fog cells, or reveal or hide the complete map.

commands.title: Add a scene light
commands.description: Add a dynamic light source to a map.

commands.title: Remove a scene light
commands.description: Remove a dynamic light source from a map.

commands.title: Update a scene light
commands.description: Move or modify a dynamic light source.

commands.title: Set dynamic lighting
commands.description: Enable or disable dynamic lighting for a map.

commands.title: Add a scene wall
commands.description: Add a wall, door, or window segment to a map.

commands.title: Remove a scene wall
commands.description: Remove a wall, door, or window segment from a map.

commands.title: Update a scene wall
commands.description: Move or change a map wall, door, or window segment.

commands.title: End a campaign session
commands.description: End an active session, optionally saving state and notes.

commands.title: Pause a campaign session
commands.description: Pause an active session and save its current state.

commands.title: Resume a campaign session
commands.description: Restore and resume the last saved campaign session.

commands.title: Start a campaign session
commands.description: Start a new campaign session as GM.

queries.title: Campaign events
queries.description: Read the bounded role-filtered campaign event feed.

queries.title: Campaign snapshot
queries.description: Read one authoritative role-filtered campaign snapshot.
